header.title: MONet Soil Schema - AnalysisAPI
header.description: MONet Soil Schema for the AnalysisAPI

sample_name.title: sample name
sample_name.description: ID that is present on the shipped sample. Human readable.

LIMS_ID.title: LIMS ID
LIMS_ID.description: An EMSL internal LIMS identifier for your sample. This will be provided by the MPOC and should not be edited.

other.title: other
other.description: Other details about your sample that you feel can't be accurately represented in the available columns.

storage_condt.title: storage condition
storage_condt.description: The storage condition of the sample. This field is NOT multivalued. If selecting other, add the `other_storage_condt` attribute to provide additional detail.

samp_store_temp.title: sample storage temperature
samp_store_temp.description: The temperature at which your samples should be stored upon arrival. This field is NOT multivalued. If selecting other, add the `other_samp_store_temp` attribute to provide additional detail.

sampling_set.title: sampling set
sampling_set.description: A sequential number to indicate soil cores collect together and to be processed together

growth_facil.title: growth facility
growth_facil.description: Type of facility or location from where the sample was collected or grown. This field is NOT multivalued. If selecting other, add the `other_growth_facil` attribute to provide additional detail.

collection_date.title: collection date
collection_date.description: The date of sampling as an instance. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Also valid, if entire collection date is unknown is just year (YYYY) or just year and month (YYYY-MM)

collection_time.title: collection time
collection_time.description: The time of sampling as an instance (single point). Required format: HH:MM:SS in 24-hour time format. Don't forget the second! (Unit: hh:mm:ss or HH:MM:SS)

sample_collection_dev.title: sample collection device
sample_collection_dev.description: The device used to collect an environmental sample. Include dimensions of device if applicable

other_treatment.title: other treatment
other_treatment.description: Many sample treatment descriptor columns are available. If a treatment is applied to your samples and the provided treatment terms do not satisfy, please add it here. Multiple treatments can be entered here, separated by ;

misc_param.title: miscellaneous parameter
misc_param.description: Any other measurement performed or parameter collected, that is not listed here

shipped_sample_size.title: shipped sample size
shipped_sample_size.description: Total amount of sample sent to EMSL. Must include unit of 'core'.

sample_collected.title: sample collected
sample_collected.description: This referes to the TOTAL amount of sample collected from the experiment. NOT the amount sent to EMSL or collected for a specific analysis. (Unit: cores)

soil_type.title: soil type
soil_type.description: Soil series name or other lower-level classification

geo_loc_name.title: geographic location name
geo_loc_name.description: The geographical origin of the sample as defined by the country or sea name followed by specific region name and site. Formatted as [Country or sea names: region or state, site]

weather.title: weather
weather.description: The state of the atmosphere at a given time and place, with respect to variables such as temperature, moisture, wind velocity, and barometric pressure.

fire.title: fire
fire.description: Historical and/or physical evidence of fire. Format: YYYY-MM-DD

flooding.title: flooding
flooding.description: Historical and/or physical evidence of flooding. Format: YYYY-MM-DD

agrochem_addition.title: agrochemical additions
agrochem_addition.description: Addition of fertilizers, pesticides, etc. - amount and time of applications

crop_rotation.title: crop rotation
crop_rotation.description: Whether or not crop is rotated, and if yes, rotation schedule

cur_land_use.title: current land use
cur_land_use.description: Present state of sample site. This slot is NOT multivalued. Valid entries: badlands, cities, conifers, crop trees, farmstead, gravel, hardwoods, hayland, horticultural plants, industrial areas, intermixed, marshlands, meadows, mines quarries, mudflats, oil waste, pastureland, permanent snow or ice, rainforest, rangeland, roads railroads, rock, row crops, saline seeps, salt flats, sand, shrub crops, shrub land, small grains, successional shrub land, swamp, tropical, tundra, vegetable crops, vine crops

drainage_class.title: drainage class
drainage_class.description: Drainage classification from a standard system such as the USDA system

ecoregion.title: ecoregion
ecoregion.description: Areas where ecosystems (and the type, quality, and quantity of environmental resources) are generally similar. A map of these regions can be found at https://www.neonscience.org/field-sites/about-field-sites. This field is NOT multivalued. Valid entries: Northeast, Mid Atlantic, Southeast, Atlantic Neotropical, Great Lakes, Prairie Peninsula, Appalachians / Cumberland Plateau, Ozarks Complex, Northern Plains, Central Plains, Southern Plains, Northern Rockies, Southern Rockies/ Colorado Plateau, Desert Southwest, Great Basin, Pacific Northwest, Pacific Southwest, Tundra, Taiga, Pacific Tropical

fao_class.title: FAO soil taxonomy classification
fao_class.description: Soil classification from the FAO World Reference Database for Soil Resources. The list can be found at https://www.isric.org/explore/world-soil-distribution

cur_vegetation.title: current vegetation
cur_vegetation.description: Vegetation classification from one or more standard classification systems, or agricultural crop

cur_vegetation_meth.title: current vegetation method
cur_vegetation_meth.description: Reference or method used in vegetation classification

infiltration_notes.title: infiltration notes
infiltration_notes.description: Provide any details, issues, or context needed to understand the infiltration activity

infiltration_1.title: first infiltration time
infiltration_1.description: Amount of time it takes to accomplish the first infiltration activity. If infiltration time was started and unsuccessful, enter 'failed', if infiltration time was not attempted enter 'did not collect'. Units and format of mm:ss required. (Example: 15:20 mm:ss)

infiltration_2.title: second infiltration time
infiltration_2.description: Amount of time it takes to accomplish the second infiltration activity. If infiltration time was started and unsuccessful, enter 'failed', if infiltration time was not attempted enter 'did not collect'. Units and format of mm:ss required. (Example: 15:20 mm:ss)

water_content_meth.title: water content method
water_content_meth.description: Reference or method used in determining the water content of soil

soil_type_meth.title: soil type method
soil_type_meth.description: Reference or method used in determining soil series name or other lower-level classification

previous_land_use_meth.title: previous land use method
previous_land_use_meth.description: Reference or method used in determining previous land use and dates

watering_regm.title: watering regimen
watering_regm.description: Information about treatment involving an exposure to watering frequencies, treatment regimen including how many times the treatment was repeated, how long each treatment lasted, and the start and end time of the entire treatment; can include multiple regimens

chem_administration.title: chemical administration
chem_administration.description: List of chemical compounds administered to the host or site where sampling occurred, and when (e.g. Antibiotics, n fertilizer, air filter); can include multiple compounds. For chemical entities of biological interest ontology (chebi) (v 163), http://purl.bioontology.org/ontology/chebi

extreme_event.title: extreme event
extreme_event.description: Unusual physical events that may have affected microbial populations. Format: YYYY-MM-DD

env_broad_scale.title: broad-scale environmental context
env_broad_scale.description: Report the major environmental system the sample or specimen came from. The system identified should have a coarse spatial grain, to provide the general environmental context of where the sampling was done (e.g. in the desert or a rainforest). We recommend using subclasses of EnvO's biome class: http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/ENVO_00000428. EnvO documentation about how to use the field: https://github.com/EnvironmentOntology/envo/wiki/Using-ENVO-with-MIxS

env_local_scale.title: local environmental context
env_local_scale.description: Report the entity which are in your sample or specimens local vicinity and which you believe have significant causal influences on your sample or specimen. Please use terms that are present in ENVO and which are of smaller spatial grain than your entry for env_broad_scale.If needed, request new terms on the ENVO tracker, identified here: http://www.obofoundry.org/ontology/envo.html

env_medium.title: environmental medium
env_medium.description: Report the environmental material immediately surrounding the sample or specimen at the time of sampling. We recommend using subclasses of 'environmental material' (http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/ENVO_00010483). EnvO documentation about how to use the field: https://github.com/EnvironmentOntology/envo/wiki/Using-ENVO-with-MIxS .

lat_lon.title: latitude longitude
lat_lon.description: The geographical origin of the sample as defined by latitude and longitude. The values should be reported in decimal format. Required format is decimal format with a comma separating the latitude, longitude.

elev.title: elevation
elev.description: Elevation of the sampling site is its height above a fixed reference point, most commonly the mean sea level. Elevation is mainly used when referring to points on the earth's surface. (Unit: m).

depth.title: depth
depth.description: The vertical distance below local surface. For sediment or soil samples depth is measured from sediment or soil surface, respectively. Depth is required to be reported as an interval for subsurface samples. (Units: cm or m)

bulk_elect_conductivity.title: bulk electrical conductivity
bulk_elect_conductivity.description: Provide the bulk electrical conductivity readout from the Teros ZSC bluetooth sensor. If measurement was started and unsuccessful, enter 'failed', if measurement was not attempted enter 'did not collect'. (Unit: mS/cm)

water_content.title: water content
water_content.description: Water content measurement. This will be a readout from the Teros ZSC bluetooth sensor and requires a unit of 'm3/m3'. If measurement was started and unsuccessful, enter 'failed', if measurement was not attempted enter 'did not collect'.

temp.title: temperature
temp.description: Temperature of the sample at the time of sampling. If measurement was started and unsuccessful, enter 'failed', if measurement was not attempted enter 'did not collect'. (Units: C)

slope_aspect.title: slope aspect
slope_aspect.description: The direction a slope faces. While looking down a slope use a compass to record the direction you are facing (degrees); e.g., 315 degrees. This measure provides an indication of sun and wind exposure that will influence soil temperature and evapotranspiration. (Unit: degrees)

slope_gradient.title: slope gradient
slope_gradient.description: Commonly called 'slope'. The angle between ground surface and a horizontal line (in percent). This is the direction that overland water would flow. This measure is usually taken with a hand level meter or clinometer. (Unit: percent)

annual_precpt.title: average annual precipitation
annual_precpt.description: The average of all annual precipitation values known, or an estimated equivalent value derived by such methods as regional indexes or Isohyetal maps. (Unit: mm)

season_precpt.title: average seasonal precipitation
season_precpt.description: The average of all seasonal precipitation values known, or an estimated equivalent value derived by such methods as regional indexes or Isohyetal maps. (Unit: mm)

neon_plot_id.title: neon plot identifier
neon_plot_id.description: When sampling from a NEON site, provide the plot ID from which you sampled. This includes the 4 letter site code followed by the 3 digit ID (Example: DEJU_048). If you do not have your NEON site, use the code SITE_999.
